reason: Deposited retained non-targeting cells all belong to provider-selected core controls in both cell types. The two planned control views have identical membership; evaluating them as distinct sensitivity conditions would misrepresent coverage.
timing: After source schema/coverage and target-knockdown inspection, during the two-repeat pilot; before the full GPU wave. No split-half or cross-cell BUB1B results used to choose this change.

changes.allocation: two cell types x four sampling-seed blocks = eight GPUs

interpretation: Additional partitions are conditional resampling, not independent biological experiments. The unavailable unselected-control test remains an explicit qualification gap. Original plan and failed/obsolete pilot attempts are preserved. No drug decision or promotion threshold changes.
